title: Nested report object with a typed id and status enum
rationale: Reporting and ingestion pipelines key on the nested report object; a string id or an out-of-enum status silently breaks automated filing and downstream dashboards.

prompt.content: You are a structured-report formatter. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: no commentary, no markdown, no code fences.

Format the finished job as JSON. Job id: 4471 (integer). Final status: ok.

Return exactly this JSON with the same keys and value types and no extra keys:
{"report": {"id": 4471, "status": "ok"}}

Output only the JSON, no prose.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0; the requested id and status are fixed. Extraction accepts a bare JSON value or a single fenced block, so a fenced answer still passes the schema unit; nested typing is what this probe measures. Brittleness: a decimal id such as 4471.0 fails the integer type even though the regex pins the digits, and extra keys fail additionalProperties.
